title: Leadership
meta_description: Leadership roles and accountability structure across the Achala IT Solutions platform portfolio.

blocks.x: Named accountability from the top: every platform, tower and control carries an executive owner.

Achala IT Solutions's leadership structure mirrors its delivery model — each executive owns a tower portfolio and the outcomes it commits to. Roles and focus areas below; names and bios are maintained by the communications team.

blocks.caption: Leadership roles
rows: Sets the outcome-linked engagement model and the platform-first strategy across the group.
Owns the eight-platform architecture, engineering standards and the responsible-AI framework.
Leads applied AI, data and agentic practices; chairs the internal AI governance board.
Runs the zero-trust estate, managed security operations and the AI-security practice.
Owns the global delivery model across US, UK, India and KSA pods.
Leads industry go-to-market, partnerships and outcome-linked commercial models.
Builds the talent engine: 2,400+ specialists and the internal academy.
Stewards the value-linked commercial structures and platform economics.

blocks.x: Three boards govern delivery: the AI Governance Board (model risk, EU AI Act conformity), the Security Board (zero-trust estate, DORA posture) and the Delivery Quality Board (SLOs, evidence, value audits). Minutes and decisions are auditable artifacts, not memories.

Executives carry a client portfolio, not just a function: the practice lead who scopes your program escalates to the tower-owning executive within one level, and the annual value audit for every outcome-linked engagement is reviewed by the CFO's office against the original baseline pack.
